what_differs: WAGR-464 (created 9/25) lists the monthly allocation upload as the first requirement and keeps the upload method open. On 9/30 the team decided to build manual allocation first and add the CSV upload afterwards, and that the CSV mapping needs scoping. WagerTech's tool may need extra fields so Salesforce can map rows to the right person and deal, and Emily agreed to add them.
suggested_action: Add the 9/30 outcome to WAGR-464: build order (manual allocation path first, CSV later) and a CSV-mapping scoping item with the WagerTech dependency (tool output must carry person and deal identifiers). Track the CSV import as its own story when the redeposit build stories are created.
